message: 素晴らしい真実

name: Azel
message: 「It's delicious...」

name: Azel
message: 「I never thought I would be able to drink this tea again.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Neither did I.」
Smiling at each other as they spoke, the two of them looked just like close sisters.
Watching that scene makes even me feel happy.

name: Melilot
message: 「Are you sure you don't want to dance anymore?」
Right about now, the dancing is probably still going on in the plaza at Finis Tower.

name: Azel
message: 「I've danced enough.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, same here.」

name: Melilot
message: 「You two wanted to be alone together, didn't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, ah, well, that's...」

name: Azel
message: 「H-How did you know!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because it is a behavioral pattern that occurs frequently among newly formed couples.」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh...」

name: Azel
message: 「I-Is that so... You're amazing, Melilot.」

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems I am intruding.」

name: Azel
message: 「Not at all. Besides, there was something I wanted to ask you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Me too.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'm listening.」

name: Azel
message: 「I have lost almost all of my spiritual essence. How long will it take before I cease to be an angel?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Let's see... For an ordinary angel, it takes about two years, but in your current state, Azel, you will likely become almost completely human in less than half a year.」

name: Synn
message: 「Human...?」
I couldn't help looking at Azel. Yet, Azel remained calm.

name: Azel
message: 「I see.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, I believe the humanization will stop if you can return to Heaven within the next few days」
But if Azel goes back to Heaven... what if she never comes back here.

name: Azel
message: 「It will only stop, you say」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. Having lost that much spiritual essence, recovery is impossible」

name: Azel
message: 「...It is extremely difficult for a being with low spiritual essence to travel to Heaven. In other words, it is practically impossible」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yet you are fine with that?」

name: Azel
message: 「Yes. I intend to live alongside Synn as a human」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...」
Azel's words are so straightforward that my chest swells with happiness.

name: Azel
message: 「Provided Synn does not reject me, of course...」

name: Synn
message: 「As if I'd ever reject you! I want to be with you forever too, Azel!」

name: Azel
message: 「Synn...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems I am intruding after all」

name: Azel
message: 「Th-That is not true at all!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I have already asked Helena to handle matters such as your family registry, so please do not worry」

name: Azel
message: 「Family registry?」

name: Melilot
message: 「When living in the Human World, going without one causes various inconveniences. You could call it an official record of whose child a person is and so forth」

name: Azel
message: 「In other words... in order to live in the Human World, I must be recorded as being related by blood to someone」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes」

name: Azel
message: 「In that case, I want to be your, um...」

name: Azel
message: 「Y-Your little sister...」

name: Azel
message: 「I-Is that no good?」

name: Melilot
message: 「N-No」
Melilot-san looked away.

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena said... she would do that for me...」

name: Azel
message: 「I-Is that so... I'm glad...」
Melilot-san cleared her throat, and.

name: Melilot
message: 「Now then, Sakura-kun, you have something you want to ask as well, don't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yes」

name: Synn
message: 「Why did Re-Crea leave Azel so easily like that?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I see」

name: Synn
message: 「As far as I'm concerned, I'm just glad Azel didn't have to suffer in pain, though... Huh? Why are you both looking at me?」
And with slightly exasperated eyes at that.

name: Azel
message: 「Did you not already know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Azel
message: 「Did you not say it yourself, Synn? That the Lord's will is not to destroy this world」

name: Synn
message: 「I did say that, but」

name: Paqy
message: 「Bet you were just winging it like usual」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, all I said was that maybe God wasn't trying to destroy the world...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It means the mechanism causing Azel-san pain was different from what I had predicted」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Azel
message: 「The cause of that pain was not the Lord. It was myself」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!? But why would you do something like hurting yourself」

name: Paqy
message: 「There are people who are into that kind of thing, you know」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is not the case here」

name: Azel
message: 「Every time I felt fondness for this world, I was overwhelmed with guilt. That was because I believed it to be rebellion against the Lord's will.」

name: Azel
message: 「Each time, I was struck by agonizing pain, and I came to believe I was being punished for defying the Lord's will.」

name: Azel
message: 「In fact, on that night I learned Synn was the Demon Lord, simply being near him brought unceasing torment.」

name: Synn
message: 「You left the apartment... because you couldn't be around me?」
Azel gave a small nod.

name: Azel
message: 「Even after that... I tried to defy the Lord's will several times... and each time, things did not go as I wished.」

name: Azel
message: 「However, if, as Synn says, the Lord's will does not desire the destruction of this world... then loving this world is no rebellion.」

name: Azel
message: 「Thus, I realized that I am allowed to love this world. The instant I did, the torment vanished.」

name: Azel
message: 「The pain was not reacting to the Lord's will, but to my own.」

name: Azel
message: 「It was as simple as that. The one binding my will was never the Lord--it was myself.」

name: Synn
message: 「So the pain stopped because your way of thinking changed, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「Precisely.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then why did the power of Re-Crea leave you?」

name: Azel
message: 「The Lord allowed me--no, allowed this world itself, through me--to choose its own fate.」

name: Azel
message: 「Whether to perish, or to endure.」

name: Synn
message: 「Meaning it left because you chose a future alongside this world, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「Yes.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then, like, there was no need for it to possess Virus.」

name: Azel
message: 「It was a test of our resolve in choosing that path. For the Lord is a stern father.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Like a lion casting its cub into a bottomless ravine, I suppose.」

name: Synn
message: 「...God sure is a strict guy, huh.」

name: Paqy
message: 「He's God, after all.」

name: Azel
message: 「Yet, because He granted us the chance to choose, the Lord is also a merciful mother.」
Setting her teacup down on the desk, Melilot

name: Melilot
message: 「It's a fascinating hypothesis, though... there's no way to prove it, is there」

name: Azel
message: 「Indeed. It's all merely my speculation」

name: Azel
message: 「However... I want to believe that's the case」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, I agree」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, there's just one thing we know for certain」

name: Synn
message: 「It's that we're alive right now」

name: Melilot
message: 「That certainly is a wonderful truth」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sounds just like you, Lord Synn」

name: Azel
message: 「It does. That's why the three of us can enjoy delicious black tea like this」

name: Melilot
message: 「What is it? You're lonely drinking by yourself? Go ahead and drink on your own」

name: Melilot
message: 「I've told you time and again, it's not as if I actually like alcohol, you know」

name: Melilot
message: 「You'll throw a tantrum if I don't come... Just how old are you!」

name: Melilot
message: 「You'll hand out photos of me when I was drunk!? A-And you call yourself the chairwoman!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Oh, Riesling is with you too? Well, if that's the case...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, yes, I understand... The Great Sage? He's right here in front of me. Ah, in that case, I'll bring him along」

name: Melilot
message: 「Whew...」

name: Synn
message: 「Was that from Ms. Helena?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. She invited me to a drinking party. Apparently she'll throw a fit if I don't go」

name: Azel
message: 「Just like a child」

name: Melilot
message: 「Indeed. Still...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Being alive is precisely what lets us share a drink together. Not that I particularly like drinking, mind you」
Standing up, Melilot effortlessly grabbed Paqy by the scruff of his collar.

name: Paqy
message: 「W-What the hell are you doing all of a sudden!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena requested that the Great Sage join us as well」

name: Paqy
message: 「I ain't going unless Ria-chan comes with us!」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you will not come, she says she will drink that vodka I showed you the other day.」

name: Paqy
message: 「W-Whaaat!? She promised she'd give that 23-year-old masterpiece to yours truly!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I can't just sit around here! That stuff belongs to me!」
Melilot handed the key to Azel.

name: Melilot
message: 「Excuse me. I don't think I'll be able to return tonight, so please make sure to lock up.」
